info.title: OpenSplit
info.description: The server stores rows and enforces one invariant. It computes nothing: splitting, folding balances, simplifying debts and analytics all happen on the device.

bearer.description: The session token from `set-auth-token`, on Android.

cookie.name: better-auth.session_token
cookie.description: The HttpOnly session cookie, on the web.

IdentityOutcomeKind.description: kept: the account id did not change. replaced: a different account holds the session now, and `strandedUserId` names the one this device's ledger belongs to.

Retry.description: stale: re-read, re-compose and send again. permanent: this will be refused identically forever; do not retry. transient: back off and try the same request again.

EmailFlow.description: linkPending: verifying keeps the current account id. signInPending: the address already has an account, so verifying replaces the session.

get.summary: Exchange rates published on or after a date
get.description: Against USD. Rates are immutable, so a device keeps a high-water mark and asks for everything after it; the most recent months are served when the window is too wide.
